🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — September 20, 2026

Moon, in detriment in Capricorn, holds a square to Mercury, in Libra. Nothing in common except the angle they hold: what you own is being counted by somebody else’s arithmetic.

Easier — Saying no to a thing you can afford and do not want.
Harder — Treating a passing squeeze as a permanent condition.
Backdrop — Jupiter and Saturn hold a month-long trine underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars rules you, fallen in Cancer. From Capricorn, Moon sets a figure against the wanting. Cardinal fire starts and is invoiced for it. After two weeks of the same angle, the terms are familiar.

♉ TAURUS
Venus governs you, out of place in Scorpio. Moon trines you from Capricorn, and what you hold finds words unforced. Fixed earth holds, and holding asks nothing back. Two weeks of this, and none of it is news.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury, your ruler, is only passing through Libra. From Virgo, Sun cuts across the appetite. Mutable air: keeping options is the expense. Four weeks ago Mercury was still in Leo: the ground has moved.

♋ CANCER
Moon rules you, exiled in Capricorn. Mercury in Libra presses on you, and the pressure is arithmetic. Water that starts things, billed for starting. What pressed a week ago has cleared.

♌ LEO
Sun, your ruler, crosses Virgo untitled. Mercury in Libra leaves a door ajar; nothing walks through it alone. Fire keeps what it has, cheaply. Two weeks of it, long enough to have stopped noticing.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury rules you from Libra, untitled. Sun crosses your sign, and nothing stays general. Earth shifts until the two options are one. A week ago Mercury was still held by Uranus; that is finished.

♎ LIBRA
Venus, your ruler, is in detriment in Scorpio. Moon in Capricorn squares you: the price shows before the wish does. Cardinal air meets a bill. Venus has been out of Libra for four weeks now.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars governs you from Cancer, where it stands lowest. From Capricorn, Moon offers an angle — offered, not delivered. Water that holds on, holding without strain. The square of a week ago is off it now.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter, your ruler, crosses Leo with no title of its own. Mercury sextiles you from Libra: help that waits to be asked for. Mutable fire: two answers, and both are affordable. Moon let go of it a week ago.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn, your ruler, falls in Aries. With Moon in your sign, nothing about worth stays abstract. Cardinal earth: beginning and paying are one act. The hold Moon had a week ago is not there any more.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn, your ruler, falls in Aries and defends what needs no defending. Mercury trines you from Libra, meeting no resistance. Fixed air: nothing needs letting go of today. Nothing about it is a week old.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter governs you, untitled in Leo. From Capricorn, Moon makes something possible and nothing certain. Mutable water: two answers, neither expensive. A week ago this angle was not there. It is now.
